summary: CEMEX filed a Form 6-K for June 2026, a routine foreign private issuer report containing cautionary statements regarding forward-looking statements. The filing explicitly states it does not constitute an offer to sell or solicitation of any offer to buy securities, nor does it announce any corporate event. No special-situation transaction (acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, etc.) or management change is disclosed. This is a standard periodic report with no actionable event.
